# /handoff

Produce a handoff another engineer or agent can resume from cold:
- Objective and current status
- Branch, changed files and uncommitted work (`git status`)
- Verified results (commands + outcomes) vs. unverified assumptions
- Blockers and the next three concrete steps

Save it so the next session starts with it: `anvil memory handoff . --content "<handoff>"` (with `kind: "handoff"` stored in `.anvil/memory.json`). With ANVIL hooks installed, the next Claude Code session receives it automatically.
